preconditions.description: The number of rows in the grid must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(row) <= 500 for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid must have a length between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in row) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: All characters in the grid must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if there exists a cycle of the same value in the grid.
The function returns False if there does not exist a cycle of the same value in the grid.
